# Phase 0 — Audit and scoping

## Goal

Establish the project boundaries, technical constraints, licensing review, Talend migration posture, and functional goals before code implementation begins.

## Deliverables

- Product vision summary
- Target architecture and module boundaries
- Initial repository layout
- MVP feature list and backlog
- Test plan and security considerations

## Acceptance criteria

- The project direction is documented.
- The architecture is clear and module-appropriate.
- The repository includes a security-first operational posture.
- The roadmap reflects incremental, testable delivery.

## Risks

- Over-scoping the tool.
- Moving too early into large dependencies.
- Underestimating Talend compatibility constraints.
